data.title: Forget GBTC. BlackRock Charges $1,250 Less a Year to Hold the Same Bitcoin on $100,000
data.description: Two Bitcoin ETFs hold the exact same asset through nearly identical structures, yet one quietly drains your account at six times the rate of the other. Before you assume switching is the obvious move, your tax situation may tell a different story.
